summary: This is an SSH configuration block that tells your computer how to connect to a remote server called 'planethoster'. It specifies the actual server address, login username, port number, and which private key file to use for authentication.

explanations.1: The 'Host' keyword defines a nickname for this server configuration that you can use later when connecting (instead of typing the full hostname).
explanations.2: HostName is the actual internet address of the server you're connecting to.
explanations.3: User specifies which username to log in with on that remote server.
explanations.4: Port tells SSH to connect on port 5022 instead of the default port 22.
explanations.5: IdentityFile points to the private cryptographic key file that proves your identity to the server; the tilde (~) is a shortcut for your home directory.
